title: Wi-Fi slow or dropping in session rooms
summary: Attendees report the conference Wi-Fi repeatedly disconnecting and crawling during keynotes and deep-dive sessions, mostly in the main halls.

title: Wi-Fi login page not working
summary: The captive portal rejects credentials or hangs at the auth step for individuals and whole delegations.

title: Microphones and room audio failing
summary: Handheld and roving mics cut out or feedback, and speakers at the back of rooms are inaudible during Q&A.

title: Signage missing or confusing between rooms
summary: Room numbers on doors, the floor maps and the app disagree, and several breakout rooms have no directional signage at all.

title: No vegan or vegetarian lunch options
summary: Restaurants and buffets for lunch have essentially no plant-based mains; what exists sells out immediately.

title: Coffee and food run out before breaks end
summary: Coffee urns and snack tables are emptied very early in each break, so latecomers get nothing.

title: Accessible seating and ramp access problems
summary: Reserved wheelchair spaces are blocked or taken, ramps are poorly signposted, and access routes are hard to find.

title: Lactation room locked and unusable
summary: The nursing room is locked for long stretches and lacks basics like a power socket and a working lock.

title: Not enough seating between sessions
summary: Corridors, lounges and overflow areas have no free chairs any time between talks.

title: Rooms either freezing or boiling
summary: HVAC is inconsistent: some breakouts are refrigerator-cold all day while the main hall heats up badly by afternoon.

title: Badge pickup and registration lines
summary: Registration queues wrap out of the lobby in the morning wave, kiosks misprint or reject badges, and help desks point people in circles.

title: Rooms double-booked for the same slot
summary: Two sessions have been scheduled into the same rooms repeatedly, forcing last-minute moves.
